title: CI checkouts keep GITHUB_TOKEN in .git/config while the global npm installs run unpinned transitive dependencies and lifecycle scripts
description:
Finding 1 of the DEC-182 (a1) Opus security review of opum-ai/ward-cli#168 (WCLI-78), whose verdict is recorded verbatim on WCLI-78; review unit ward-cli-review-168, SHA 2d8c04bab3c9a5bea36406d10ce914e047dc38f0, verdict APPROVE, verdict file sha256 57f4e32b50646b63. Pre-existing and NON-BLOCKING for #168 -- the review states it was not introduced by that change. Filed so it is not lost with the review, and NOT started.

THE FINDING: ci.yml:72 and ci.yml:111 are the Docs and Tracker checkouts, and neither sets persist-credentials: false, so actions/checkout leaves the job GITHUB_TOKEN in .git/config. ci.yml:81 and ci.yml:131 then run `npm install --global` for the pinned @opum-ai/lore and @opum-ai/quest with no lockfile and no --ignore-scripts, so their transitive dependency ranges and lifecycle scripts are resolved and executed unpinned at CI time, with that token sitting readable on disk. Both jobs hold no secrets and the token is contents:read, but that is contents:read on a private repository whose product is secret management. The version-equality check after each install compares only the top-level version, so it would not catch a compromised transitive dependency.

SUGGESTED FIX, from the review: set persist-credentials: false on both checkouts, which only read the tree. OPTIONAL AND NOT THIS TASK: --ignore-scripts on the global installs, or a shrinkwrap shipped by lore/quest. The review frames both as a design question for opum-doc, and opum-agent has routed that half to opum-doc as fleet-wide. Record which way it goes so the two halves are not confused for one another.

DEC-182 (1) FLOOR, recorded because the finding concerns CI: implementation runs on a model at or above Sonnet and NEVER on DeepSeek, and it lands only after an Opus review. The moving writer for this repository currently runs deepseek-flash, so opum-agent dispatches this to a Sonnet writer when it gets a plan slot; it is not to be implemented from the ward-cli session itself.

SCOPE: one workflow file, two checkouts. No change to job names, required contexts, permissions, triggers or action pins.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Both checkouts that only read the tree -- the Docs job at ci.yml:72 and the Tracker job at ci.yml:111 -- set persist-credentials: false, and no other checkout in ci.yml is left persisting credentials without a recorded reason
The diff changes no job name, required context, permission, trigger or action pin, and Check, Docs and Tracker integrity all stay green on the PR head SHA
The record states which way the --ignore-scripts / shrinkwrap half went, or that it rests with opum-doc, so that half is not silently dropped
The implementation was authored by a model at or above Sonnet and never DeepSeek, and an Opus review verdict is recorded on the PR before merge, per DEC-182 (1)

implementationNotes: DEC-240 (opum-doc, 2026-10-25 14:10Z) folds this task in as the ward-cli CI-hardening task; plan item 13 approved by dec-00icl6f = A (2026-10-26T13:43:57Z). It answers the optional half of this task: --ignore-scripts went in (no shrinkwrap). Item 1 applies: both global installs (Docs lore, Tracker quest) in ci.yml now pass --ignore-scripts. Item 2 applies: all 3 checkouts (Check, Docs, Tracker) set persist-credentials: false; none pushes or fetches later, so no exemption. Item 3 applies: the Tracker version is now read by scripts/read-quest-version.mjs, only between the quest:agent-instructions markers, must match ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$, fails with ::error naming the value. Item 4 measured: the only step output used in a shell step (QUEST_VERSION) already reaches it through env:; no ${{ }} appears inside any run: body; test/ci-hardening.test.ts pins that. No SHA pinning change.

PROOF both ways, npm 12.2.0 / node v24.20.0 locally. Fixture: host-pkg depending on bad-dep whose postinstall writes a marker and exits 1, both installed from tarballs. (a) npm install --global --dangerously-allow-all-scripts --prefix ./p4 ./host-pkg-1.0.0.tgz: exit 1, marker written (the control, the failing postinstall does fire). (b) npm install --global --ignore-scripts --dangerously-allow-all-scripts --prefix ./p2 ./host-pkg-1.0.0.tgz: exit 0, host-pkg runs, no marker. Note npm 12 blocks dependency scripts by default and only warns, so the control needed the allow flag; the runner npm (node 24, npm 11) runs them by default, which is why the explicit flag is the guard. (c) npm install --global --ignore-scripts @opum-ai/lore@0.14.1 @opum-ai/quest@0.14.1: lore --version 0.14.1, quest --version 0.14.1, so neither CLI needs its own install scripts. Version read: bun test test/ci-hardening.test.ts, 13 pass, rejects 0.14, 0.14., 0.14.1-beta.1, ^0.14.1, latest, 0.14.1.2 each by name with empty stdout, ignores a declaration outside the block, fails on missing markers, and accepts this repo CLAUDE.md. bun run check: 785 pass.

Opus APPROVE, rv326-ward175, 2026-10-26, at 4f3c40bbefa33bf6bf96bab7cf989ccee35d4637. Landed as 372b0475bc08cc7727b1831bb61875ea243b64b1 on dev (ward-cli#175 squash, --match-head-commit); not promoted to main.

OPEN, OUTSIDE DEC-240 SCOPE: the transitive dependency pinning half of this title. DEC-240 drops the shrinkwrap, so lore and quest transitive dependency ranges still resolve unpinned at CI time. --ignore-scripts closes only install-time lifecycle scripts, not a compromised transitive dependency version.

RUNNER-LINE CONTROL, npm 11.21.1 via npx -y npm@11, fixture host-pkg with a bad-dep postinstall that exits 1, no allow flags: install -g without --ignore-scripts exit 1 and marker written; with --ignore-scripts exit 0, host-pkg runs, no marker. This supersedes the npm 12 control above, which needed --dangerously-allow-all-scripts.
Follow-up WCLI-81 (Low) filed for the version reader untested edges.
finalSummary: DEC-240 applied to ci.yml in ward-cli#175, landed as 372b047 on dev after Opus APPROVE (rv326-ward175). --ignore-scripts on both global installs, persist-credentials: false on all three checkouts, Quest version read exactly from inside the managed block. Proven both ways on npm 11 and npm 12. Transitive dependency pinning stays open and outside DEC-240 scope; reader edge tests are WCLI-81.
